translation.name: Pab tummad karta pab Jesucristobal igal-pin mezhijad

content: Kwenadgan pe nuekwá takenabmal, tule chunchunnad Pab Purpa Nuedbal chunmadanimal o chul-dewa

Kwenadgan-pilalmalad, imi iti-napkin ichejul Pab-kaka-palchoged-chunchunnadzhulmalad irmamal-choggu, al pe melle yogasal tule-chunmadanimaladgin ibzhemalo. Tenal pemaldin, pe we tule-wilub-takenabgwel Pab-Purpabal chunmajii o nia-purpabal chunmajimal.
¿Anmal igi wisgunoniko, tule Pab-Purpa-Nuedbal chunmajii-dewa o chul? Nabir. Imi meke-ibi-tule chogel, Jesucristo iti-napche chunchunnad sanal noni, we tule Pab-Purpa-Nuedbal chunmajii.

Tenal meke-ibi-tule chogel, Jesucristo sanal kwen nonijul, we tule Pab-Purpa-Nuedbal kwen chunmajul, we tule nia-purpabal chunma. Tenal tule-yami-Cristoyob-tanikoed ampa nia-purpabal immal imanonimogo. Tenal pe itosmaldo, we purpa iti-napche noniko, tenal imidin pato kudii.
Nuskan-pilalmalad, imi pemal Pabgadmal, tegin Pab-Purpa-Nued-pemalgin-mai. Tenal Pab Purpa Nued, iti-napkined-purpa-iskanaga pul tule-tummad-choggu, al pemal tule-kakanzhemaladgin nakwismal.
Tenal tulemal-kakanzhemalad iti-napkinmalad-choggu, al immal-iti-napkinmaladginbi chunma, tegin tule-iti-napkin-pukmalad yer we tulemal-chunmaked itomal.

Tenal anmal Pabgad-choggu, al tule-pel-kwapa-Pab-wismalad yer anmal-itomal. Tenal tule-pel-kwapa Pabgadzhulil, anmal-kwen-itojulmal. Tenal an-pemalga-chogzhiidyob kunonikil, anmal mag taknoniko, toa-tule Purpa-Chunchunnad-nika, tegin toa-tulemal purpa-kakanzheed-nikabal.
Pab kusgu pela-pela tule-pilal
Kwenadgan-pilalmalad, imi tule-pilalgued Pab-akar tani-choggu, al anmal aga emal-emal pilalguenabmalmo. Imi meke-ibi-tule, tule-pid-pilalel, Pabgin purpal mimmiles, tegin Pab-nued-wisbal.
Tenal Pab kusgu pela-pela tule-pilal-choggu, al meke-ibi-tule, tule-pid-pilalzhulil, ampa Pab-kwen-wichulmo.
Tenal Pab Tummad iti-napche e-Machi-Walkwénnagwad-palminoni, anmal e-Machibal ilagwen-nadgu tullegal. Al mag taklenoni Pab Tummad chunchunnad anmal-pilalgus.

¿Imi anmal kepegin Pab-Tummad-pilalgunoni pe ebinzhe? Chulá. Tenal Pab Tummad kepegin anmal-pilalgunoni, tegin e-Machi-palminoni, immal-kugedgin-immal-uklegedyob anmal-anal iskued penukkal. Wedin tule-pilalgued-chunchunnad.
Kwenadgan-pilalmalad, imi Pab Tummad pela-pela anmal-pilalgus-choggu, al anmal aga emal-emal pilalgued-wilubmalmo.
Tenal tule Pab-Tummad-kwen-taktijulmal. Tenal anmal aga emal-emal pilalmalal, Pab Tummad anmalgin mai, tegin Pab-tule-pilaled anmalbal kep mag taklenonimogo.
Imi Pab anmalga E-Purpa-Nued-ukcha-choggu, al anmal wismaldo, anmal Pabgin mai, tegin Pabde anmalgin maimo.
Imi anmal imial Jesucristo-takchadbal pemalga chogmal, Pab Tummad aga e-Machi-palmial pel-kwapa-iti-napkin-pukmalad-abonogal.
Imi meke-ibi-tule chogel: “Jesús, Pab-Machi-chunchunnad,” Pab Tummad we tulegin mai, tegin we tule Pab Tummadgin maimo.

Tenal anmal mag taknonimal-choggu Pab anmal-pilal, al anmal Pab-penzhul-kunonimal, Pabde chunchunnad anmal-pilal. Imi Pab Tummad kusgu pela-pela tule-pilal. Al meke-ibi-tule tule-pilaledgin naneel, we tule Pab Tummadgin mai, tegin Pab Tummad we tulegin maimo.

¿Ibiga Pab-tule-pilaled anmalgin napírra oyolenoni pe ebinzhe? Nabir. Imi Pab tule-iti-napkin-pukmaladga-igal-itononikil, anmal Pabyob iti-napkin tule-pilaledgin-nanajadbal, anmal kwen tobguojul-kuo, tenal anmal aga ulubgin akalzhul-itononimalbalo.

Tenal anmal chunchunnad tulemal-pilalel, anmal kwen tobzhul-kuo. Tenal Pab-sapejul-tule-oturdakoedbal, tule kwakidago-choggu, al Pab-tule-pilaled-chunchunnaddin tobed-igegal tule-ima. Tenal tule ampa Pab-tobel, ampa napi pela-pela tule-pilalgugal.
Imi Pab kepegin anmal-pilalgus-choggu, al anmal Pab-pilalmalmo.

Tenal meke-ibi-tule chogel: “An Pab-pilal,” tenal we tule ampa istar kwenad-takel, we tule kakanchili. Tenal meke-ibi-tule kwenad-mag-taked-istar-taktiil, Pab-Tummad-taktijulidbal ¿igi Pab-Tummad-pilalgumogo? Keg kue.
Tenal Pab anmalga chogzhado: imi meke-ibi-tule Pab-pilalel, we tule keg-chulgu aga kwenad-pilalguenabmalmo.
